_doc: Allowlist for yarn audit high/critical advisories in the ROOT tree that cannot be fixed in the current branch. Every entry needs a reason and a review date. See SUPPLY-CHAIN-SECURITY.md (added in Phase 4) and CONTRIBUTING.md ('Supply-chain checks').
_keep_when_empty: Do NOT delete this file when entries: [] is empty. The empty file is the running assertion of 'audit gate exists AND zero current debt' — it pre-paves the schema for the next suppression, preserves git history of past suppressions, keeps the CODEOWNERS-routed surface, and lets the cross-repo tracker distinguish 'clean gate' (count=0) from 'wrapper pattern not in use' (no file at all). Burn down ENTRIES; keep the FILE.

_fields.id: npm advisory numeric ID (from `yarn audit --json` advisory.id) — REQUIRED, used for matching
_fields.ghsa: GitHub Security Advisory ID (e.g., GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx) — for humans, not used for matching
_fields.reason: why the advisory is allowlisted — upstream has no fix, major-version bump deferred, not on a reachable code path, etc.
_fields.added: YYYY-MM-DD when the entry was added — REQUIRED
_fields.review: YYYY-MM-DD by which the entry must be re-evaluated — REQUIRED. An expired entry prints a CI warning but does not fail the job.

entries.reason: No patched release (<=1.4.0, no fix yet). The flaw is in RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification; Pearl only uses node-forge in electron/main.js to generate the localhost self-signed key and certificate, and never verifies signatures with it, so the vulnerable path is unreachable. Upgrade once a fixed version ships.

No patched release (<=3.0.3, and 3.0.3 is the latest published braces). The flaw is stack exhaustion when expanding deeply nested brace patterns. braces is only reached via sass>@parcel/watcher>micromatch, and sass loads @parcel/watcher only inside watchDir() for `sass --watch`; Pearl compiles SCSS at build time through Next.js and never runs the sass watcher, and the glob patterns are never attacker-supplied, so the vulnerable path is unreachable. Remove once a fixed braces ships.
